limits: Uses complete retained edit history within one project's lifetime; no persistent ledger/cache/schema change or migration.

Queries result.createdIds and inverse identity fields only for batches with creations; work grows with stored history size and is not a constant-time guarantee. Extreme-history performance remains unmeasured.
Existing histories that already reused identity or omitted canonical IDs are not rewritten or repaired. Prior validation snapshots remain historical.
Trusted pure-domain functions permit restoration; public fresh edits always reach ApplyNewTransaction regardless of source string.
No new real Wails UI/process-kill/power-loss, physical audio/device, real model, clean install or dense-page performance acceptance.
